Interface ICertificateAuthenticator

Namespace
NuvTools.Security.Certificate
Assembly
NuvTools.Security.dll

Authenticates a person by a digital certificate, in two steps: the server opens a challenge, the client signs it with the certificate's private key, and the server validates the signature.

public interface ICertificateAuthenticator

Remarks

The identity is read from the certificate on the server, after the provider confirmed possession of the private key and the trust chain. Call CompleteAsync(string?, CancellationToken) inside the sign-in operation itself and take the identity from its result — never from a value the client sends.
